note: Warren County PA (42123) publishes no queryable zoning-district polygon layer. The county zoning ordinance covers 12 of 27 municipalities and the official county zoning map is kept at the planning office (PDF/paper). City of Warren publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (adopted 11-17-2025). No county GIS portal publishes zoning. The only queryable layer found is the PASDA county tax parcel layer (mapservices.pasda.psu.edu WarrenCounty/MapServer/0) with a ZONING attribute, but it is filled for only 109 of 262 sampled parcels (about 42 percent), which fails validation (zone fill check); it is not a district layer.
